meta.title: x/tools/gopls: completion has wrong textedit in some cases
meta.fix_ref: golang/tools@1587f35e0f29 (gopls/internal/server/completion: get correct surrounding for second lhs)
meta.build_notes: Both built and run with go1.24.4 (golang.org/dl, under temp/lsp_servers/go-sdks; toolchain.json), as for the other v0.18.1/v0.19.0 cases: the local go1.27 cannot build v0.18.1 and go1.24.0 cannot build v0.19.0. The issue was reported 2025-03-09 against master; v0.18.1 was tagged 2025-02-24, v0.19.0 2025-06-10.
meta.notes: For 'left,ri' (an assignment's left-hand side cut short) gopls found no identifier for the second operand (the fix's message: the expression list parses as an ExprStmt rather than a BadExpr, so no surrounding was computed), and the completion's replacement range was empty at the cursor, so the client appended the item ('riright'). The statement is a parse error before and after the completion and gopls suppresses type errors in files with parse errors, so the case uses the specification probe edit_text_differs with the output the issue expects.

a module around the file; go 1.24, the Go of the era

repro.steps: Open f.go. Request completion with the cursor on 'ri' in 'left,ri' (line 3, character 8, the end of 'ri') and accept 'right'. Reported: 'left,riright'; expected (issue): 'left,right'. Probe (specification): the edited f.go must equal the issue's expected function text (after the same package clause).
